title: Early Closing of a Credit Builder Account: Settlement From Savings and the Borrower's Confirmation
content:
## Settlement at an early closing

When a Credit Builder account closes early, part of the locked savings is applied to what the borrower owes on the loan. At an early closing, and only at an early closing, the savings applied to the loan are figured as the Credit Builder Accounts early-closure settlement sets out; at a delinquency closing the savings still pay, in order, the closing interest (the loan balance times the APR divided by 365 times the days from the last due date paid through the closing date, rounded to the cent), the loan balance and unpaid fees, applied only up to the savings balance, with anything still owed remaining a debt of the borrower.

The savings applied at an early closing are fixed only after the account's oldest unpaid due date, once its grace period has ended with the installment still unpaid, carries its late fee, unless that late fee comes to 0.00.

The early-closure settlement is not figured until the early-closure late-fee relief owed on the account, if any, has been granted.

The savings applied at an early closing are fixed only once the early-closure returned-fee relief owed on the account, if any, has been granted.

A confirmed early closure closes the account on the confirmation date, and closing interest is counted through that date; the remaining savings are released on a business day after the closing date, never on the closing date itself. When the savings applied come to 0.00, the early closure is still confirmed with nothing applied to the loan.

| Closing | Savings applied |
|---|---|
| early closure confirmed by the borrower | figured under the early-closure settlement, fixed only once the conditions above hold |
| delinquency closing | closing interest, loan balance and unpaid fees, in that order, up to the savings balance |

## The borrower's confirmation: `confirm_early_closure_8372931d`

**What it does.** With this tool the borrower confirms their own pending early-closure request and closes their Credit Builder account. Confirming marks the early-closure request as confirmed, closes the account early today (status closed early, closing date today, closing reason borrower early close), and books the savings applied to the loan: the confirmed amount is taken out of the locked savings certificate as one savings-applied entry dated today. The borrower sees the account closed and the savings balance reduced by the amount applied.

**How it is invoked.** It is the borrower's own tool: the agent unlocks `confirm_early_closure_8372931d` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `builder_closure_id` | reference number of the borrower's pending early-closure request, as returned by the early-closure request lookup |
| `builder_account_id` | reference number of the Credit Builder account being closed, as returned by the Credit Builder account lookup |
| `savings_applied_amount` | the amount of savings applied to the loan at closing in USD, an amount of 0.00 or more with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation of the form "Early closure confirmed: account <account reference> closed on <YYYY-MM-DD>; savings applied entry <entry reference> of <amount> USD; savings balance now <amount> USD.", where amounts are in USD with 2 decimal places and the savings balance is what remains on the certificate. Receiving this text means the account is closed early and the savings were applied.
